scope: Finite states, body support, ten passive caster DOFs, short low-speed motion, relative closed-loop frame stability. Does not calibrate contact slip, forces, masses or hardware behavior.
launch_command: ros2 launch hamr_ball_caster ball_caster.launch.py model:=compa gui:=false controller:=false
shutdown_note: The rootless Gazebo launcher wrapper required SIGTERM after SIGINT; the remaining Gazebo server then exited on direct SIGINT. These post-test shutdown messages are present in compa_launch.log. All owned processes were confirmed stopped.
